entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David, and you've reached VeloFit Customer Support. How can I help you today?
Yeah, finally. I need to return this ridiculous jersey I bought. I've been a customer for years and this is just unacceptable. I want my money back, now.
I'm very sorry to hear there's an issue with your order. I can certainly look into that for you. Do you have your order number handy?
It's VF-889-1024. And let me tell you, this Aero Race Jersey is a joke. It's the wrong size, completely. It's so tight I can barely breathe. If you don't fix this, I'm posting reviews everywhere.

I understand your frustration, and I appreciate you providing that order number. I'm pulling it up now. Just so I'm clear, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault with the jersey, or a preference issue with the fit?
Are you not listening? I just told you! It's too tight! It's the wrong size! I need to do an exchange or get a refund. This is an absolute waste of my time. Get me your manager.

I can definitely handle this for you, no need to escalate. I just needed to confirm the details. Let me quickly check the return eligibility for you... Okay, I see the delivery was 16 days ago. Our policy allows for returns on standard items for up to 90 days.
Wait, really? So you can just... take it back?

Absolutely. You're well within the return window. I've just initiated the process and sent a prepaid return label to the email address on file. Once we receive the jersey, would you prefer a full refund or an exchange for a larger size?
Oh. Well... that was easy. A full refund, please. Thank you. I appreciate you taking care of that so quickly.
Of course. I've noted your preference for a refund. The email with the label is on its way. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you, David.
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a great day.
